name: Number9VR XR Player
summary:
Number9VR XR Player is a virtual reality playback application for medical education and professional training.

It gives authorized users access to 360° recordings of medical procedures and related educational experiences supplied by healthcare organizations and other content owners. Depending on the experience, playback may include chapter navigation and picture-in-picture views to review additional procedural detail.
